name: magpie-prompt-match
description: Magpie plugin that dynamically loads, filters, and injects model-specific AGENTS.md prompts across routing groups, fallbacks, and protocols.

summary.en: Dynamically load and filter model-specific AGENTS.md prompts per resolved model, supporting routing groups, fallbacks, and a built-in rule manager UI.
summary.zh: 按最终命中的模型动态加载与裁剪 AGENTS.md 提示词，支持路由组、Fallback 精准匹配及内置可视化规则管理页。
